function: Learned feedback-free selection of the precoder, rank indicator and CQI from user geolocation, using VAE for representative precoders and GPR for spatial inference (p. 5, 9-11).
system: Downlink single-user MIMO-OFDM in FD-RAN, BS 16 dual-polarized antennas (8x1 ports), UE 4 antennas, 3.5 GHz, 15 kHz subcarrier spacing; no RIS (p. 4, 11).
method: VAE per rank (four-layer fully connected, unsupervised ELBO training) plus Gaussian process regression of latent means from location (supervised); offline training (p. 8-12).
data_channel: DeepMIMO O1 ray-tracing (BS1, User Grid 1) turned into 3GPP TR 38.901 CDL channels; 100 random-seeded time samples per location; 3780 training, 945 testing locations (p. 11-12).
test_conditions: Training: 3780 UE locations of DeepMIMO O1 (BS1), 100 time samples. Testing: 945 other locations; also trained at zero speed, tested at 5-15 km/h (p. 11, 16).
baselines: Non-learned: feedback-based 5G CLSM, CPM-codebook, CPM-SVD, and the authors' statistic-based codebook approach; no earlier learned method compared (p. 12, 15).
metrics: Average throughput (Mbps) from a 5G link-level simulator, throughput loss versus CLSM (%), VAE reconstruction throughput, fixed RI maps, CQI heatmaps (p. 12-17).
complexity: Inference O(log Q) for codebook lookup (p. 7); SVD-based GPR space O(Q^2) and time O(Q^3), decoder layers 10L-128-400-2NtxL (p. 11); no runtime.
openness: none for own code or data; uses public DeepMIMO [43] (p. 11).
q1_support: p. 11: "realistic ray-tracing dataset: DeepMIMO [43]" and "clustered delay line (CDL) channels between BS and UE are generated according to standard [44]"; p. 18: "3GPP TR 38.901 V16.1.0".
q2_support: p. 16: "VAE-based solution 1 is trained using a channel dataset at zero user speed"; Fig. 18 tests it at 0, 5, 10 and 15 km/h, and p. 17: "despite being trained with a dataset at a fixed user speed".
q3_support: p. 12: "there are no existing studies on feedback-free MIMO"; it is compared only with feedback-based 5G CLSM and CPM (non-learned) and its own statistic-based variant, so no earlier learned baseline.
q4_support: p. 11: "the inverse of the covariance matrix in GPR, is O(Q3 )"; p. 11: "the space complexity of GPR is known as O(Q2 )".
q5_support: p. 11: "realistic ray-tracing dataset: DeepMIMO [43]"; the public DeepMIMO O1 scenario is used for training and testing, and no link to the authors' own code is given.
notes: Area 3 rather than 2: the learned VAE and GPR output the precoder, RI and CQI from location, and the main metric is throughput (p. 5, 12); reviewer to confirm. The codebook-based approach is statistical, not a learned network. q2 rests on the zero-speed training versus 5-15 km/h test (p. 16), which is borderline as a new condition; the BS5 dataset (p. 17) looks like a separate per-BS mapping and is not counted. The 3GPP CDL conversion of DeepMIMO is stated on p. 11.
